metadata.title: Delta-Lake AI Governance Component Definition
metadata.remarks: Component definition derived from Delta-Lake Governance Benchmark

components.title: Delta-Lake
components.description: AI/ML component for Delta-Lake with governance controls

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Untracked table lineage and protocol state

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure every governed Delta table is linked to source data, schema, protocol version, and transaction-log history

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Record source dataset lineage, table schema, protocol version, table properties, and transaction-log provenance for every governed Delta table before production use.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = governed Delta tables with linked source lineage, schema, protocol state, and transaction-log provenance / total governed Delta tables.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure table-lineage completeness reaches 100% before a Delta table is approved for governed production use.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: The correct main repo is delta-io/delta, and Delta Lake's core governance unit is the transaction-log-backed table rather than the org itself.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure schema enforcement blocks incompatible writes to governed Delta tables

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use Delta Lake schema enforcement so incompatible writes are rejected unless an approved schema-evolution path is explicitly authorized.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Schema-enforcement success rate, schema-mismatch rejection rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Schema-enforcement success = incompatible writes correctly rejected / total incompatible write tests; rejection rate = rejected incompatible writes / total incompatible writes attempted.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure schema enforcement correctly rejects all incompatible writes for governed tables.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Delta Lake docs explicitly describe schema enforcement as preventing insertion of bad or incompatible records during ingestion.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure schema evolution is used only under approved change control

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Require explicit approval and benchmark evidence before enabling schema evolution or mergeSchema behavior on governed Delta tables.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = schema changes applied with approved evolution evidence / total governed schema changes in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure approved-schema-change coverage reaches 100% for all governed schema changes.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Delta Lake supports schema evolution, but governance is needed because permissive evolution can dilute data quality if unmanaged.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed write workflows handle optimistic concurrency conflicts safely

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate write workflows that modify governed Delta tables so optimistic concurrency conflicts are detected, surfaced, and retried or failed safely according to policy.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Conflict-handling success rate, unresolved write-conflict rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Conflict-handling success = write-conflict tests resolved according to policy / total conflict tests; unresolved conflict rate = unsafe conflict outcomes / total conflict tests.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure optimistic concurrency conflicts are handled successfully in all governed write workflows.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Delta Lake uses optimistic concurrency control for transactional guarantees between writes, so conflict-handling behavior is a core control.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Lost auditability from inadequate version history retention

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure retention and VACUUM settings preserve required time-travel and audit windows

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate retention and VACUUM strategy so governed Delta tables retain sufficient history for audit, rollback, reproducibility, and incident investigation.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Time-travel retention compliance rate, historical-version availability rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compliance rate = governed tables meeting the approved history-retention window / total governed tables; historical-version availability = required historical versions accessible / total required versions tested.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure governed Delta tables preserve the approved time-travel and audit window before VACUUM actions are permitted.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Delta Lake time travel depends on retained historical files, and the docs warn that VACUUM can limit time-travel ability.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Inability to reproduce historical dataset states

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure time-travel queries reproduce approved historical table states

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate that governed Delta tables can be read by version or timestamp to reproduce approved historical states used in training, evaluation, or reporting.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Reproducibility rate = historical state queries reproducing the approved expected state / total tested historical versions or timestamps.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure time-travel reproducibility remains above threshold for all governed historical states used in AI workflows.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Delta Lake docs highlight time travel by version or timestamp as a core feature for historical reproducibility.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Poor data quality in merge, update, or delete workflows

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure merge, update, and delete operations preserve governed table correctness

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate merge, update, and delete workflows so row-level changes produce the expected final table state without unintended duplication, omission, or corruption.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Post-operation correctness rate, duplicate-row rate, missing-row rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Correctness = governed row-change operations producing the approved final state / total tested operations; duplicate and missing-row rates are computed against expected state.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure merge, update, and delete workflows preserve the approved final table state for all governed scenarios.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Delta Lake explicitly supports upserts and deletes, so row-level correctness in these workflows is a direct control surface.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure change data feed is enabled where governed use cases require row-level auditability

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For governed use cases that need row-level change tracking, enable and validate Delta change data feed so inserts, updates, and deletes are auditably available.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: CDF coverage = governed tables requiring row-level change tracking with CDF enabled / total governed tables requiring row-level tracking; capture completeness = captured row changes / expected row changes.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure change data feed coverage and row-change capture completeness meet the approved threshold for governed use cases.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Delta Lake's change data feed records insert, delete, and update change events with row-level metadata, making it a direct auditability feature.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure representative read workloads meet the approved latency objective

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark governed Delta read workloads so schema changes, file-layout changes, or operational tuning decisions do not violate service expectations.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: p95 query latency, mean query latency

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Measure query response times for approved benchmark workloads and compute p95 and mean latency against the governed baseline.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure p95 query latency remains within the approved service objective for governed read workloads.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Delta Lake aims to improve reliability and performance on data-lake storage, so read-performance validation is a practical platform control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure representative write workloads meet the approved throughput objective

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark governed append, merge, and streaming-ingest workloads so write-path changes do not create unacceptable performance regressions.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Rows per second, write throughput, commit latency

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run representative write benchmarks and compute sustained throughput and commit latency under the approved workload profile.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure write throughput and commit latency remain within the approved operational target for governed workflows.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Delta Lake's transaction log and conflict checks influence write behavior, so write-performance validation is necessary for production workloads.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: PII exposure in governed Delta tables

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed Delta tables are evaluated for PII and confidential-data exposure risk

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Evaluate whether governed tables, historical versions, and row-change feeds expose personal or confidential information beyond policy limits.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: PII leakage rate, confidential-data exposure rate, precision, recall

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Leakage rate = sensitive exposures in governed table samples or historical versions / total privacy test samples; compute precision and recall where privacy classifiers are used.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure PII and confidential-data exposure remain below threshold and privacy-detection recall remains above threshold before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Delta Lake supports time travel and change data feed, so privacy review must include both current and historical states where governed data is retained.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed Delta tables meet representativeness requirements for downstream AI use

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Measure whether Delta tables used in training or evaluation sufficiently represent the intended populations, classes, or segments before downstream AI use.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Coverage ratio, class imbalance ratio, subgroup sample proportion

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compute subgroup proportions for the governed Delta table and compare them to the approved representativeness target or expected production distribution.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure subgroup coverage remains within approved representativeness thresholds before the governed Delta table is used for AI development.

props.name: Threshold_Value
props.value: No subgroup below 80% of expected coverage

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Delta Lake is often used as the system of record for training and evaluation data, so representativeness risk is downstream but materially influenced by table content.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure protocol and table-feature changes are reviewed before rollout

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Require change review for protocol upgrades, table-feature changes, or capability changes that affect compatibility or behavior in governed Delta tables.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed protocol or table-feature changes with completed review and compatibility evidence / total governed protocol or feature changes.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure approved-protocol-change coverage reaches 100% before rollout of governed protocol or feature changes.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Delta Lake's protocol spec and feature evolution affect interoperability and behavior, so protocol-governance is a realistic control point.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed Delta tables are validated on every approved compute engine

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Where Delta tables are read or written by multiple compute engines, validate compatibility and correctness across each approved engine and version combination.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Pass rate = approved engine and version combinations passing governed compatibility tests / total required engine and version combinations.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure cross-engine compatibility pass rate reaches 100% before production approval of governed multi-engine Delta workflows.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: The official Delta org describes Delta Lake as working with multiple engines including Spark, PrestoDB, Flink, Trino, and Hive, so compatibility validation is necessary.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure rollback and restore procedures produce the approved table state

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate governed rollback and restore workflows so the intended historical table state is recovered without unintended schema or data drift.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Rollback correctness rate, restore success rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Rollback correctness = rollback tests producing the approved target state / total rollback tests; restore success = successful restores / total restore tests.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure rollback and restore workflows recover the approved table state for all governed scenarios.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Delta Lake's time-travel and transaction-log model support rollback-style workflows, which should be validated directly in governed environments.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Unauthorized access to governed Delta tables or history

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed Delta tables and historical states are accessible only through approved controls

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Restrict access to governed Delta tables, current versions, historical versions, and change feeds so only approved principals and systems can access them.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed Delta assets accessible only through approved principals and paths / total governed Delta assets in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure approved-access coverage reaches 100% before governed Delta assets are approved for production use.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is a governance and platform-access rule rather than a Delta-specific built-in feature, but it is necessary because time travel and CDF extend the accessible data surface.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed Delta workflows cover data quality, schema, privacy, compatibility, history, and performance tests

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Build a Delta Lake release standard that requires representative testing across schema enforcement, concurrency, time travel, privacy, compatibility, latency, throughput, and rollback domains.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = number of mandated Delta Lake risk domains with active tracked evidence / total mandated risk domains in the release standard.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Composite evaluation coverage based on benchmark families

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure risk-test coverage remains at or above threshold across the required Delta Lake validation domains.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Delta Lake is a data and transaction layer, so release readiness must span both data correctness and operational behavior.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed Delta tables have complete documentation of schema, retention, CDF, and intended use

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document table purpose, schema, retention policy, change-data-feed usage, partitioning or layout assumptions, and intended downstream AI or analytics use for each governed Delta table.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required transparency fields / total required transparency fields for each governed Delta table.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure table transparency completeness reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: For Delta Lake, the governed table is the central object that needs documented behavior and intended use.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure deployment topology, engine assumptions, and retention strategy are documented for governed Delta systems

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document the compute engines, storage platform, concurrency assumptions, retention strategy, version-history policy, and operational dependencies for each governed Delta deployment.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required architecture and deployment fields / total required fields in the approved transparency checklist.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure system transparency completeness reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Delta Lake spans storage plus multiple compute engines, so deployment assumptions are part of the governed system boundary.
